description: Free: without code, sends a one-time code to the registrant email of a domain no account owns (the answer is the same whether or not it qualifies); with code, replaces the domain token. The code works once, for 60 minutes. Ask your user for the code; never guess it.

code.description: Leave out to send a one-time code to the registrant email; then call again with the code from that mail.

domain.description: The domain, e.g. example.com (an offered TLD: info, domains.tlds).

name: domain_token_email
title: New domain token through the registrant email (free)
